# QudSchool — Full Content for LLMs

> QudSchool (كود سكول) is an AI-powered educational platform teaching programming, computer science, robotics, game development, and AI fundamentals to children and teenagers. Delivered in Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR).

Canonical URL: https://qudschool.com

---

## Who we are

QudSchool is an educational platform preparing the next generation of technology leaders. Students learn through interactive courses, real hands-on projects, and a modern supportive environment.

- Founder & CEO: Hossam Galal
- Team: Hassan Orabi (Development Lead), Omar Essam (Tech Lead), Amr Mohamed Galal (Founding Member)
- Students: 2,000+
- Founded: 2023
- Partners: Google, Microsoft, MIT, Stanford, UNICEF
- Languages: Arabic (default, RTL) and English (LTR)

---

## Programs

- **Primary Stage Programming** — foundations for young learners.
- **Game Development Program** — from concepts to publishable games.
- **AI Classroom Program** — hands-on AI literacy.
- **Robotics & STEM Program** — physical computing and robotics.
- **Future Programmers Track** — long-form track toward professional skills.

---

## Live Sessions

QudSchool offers live interactive sessions with certified instructors:

- **Group Sessions** — up to 6 students, 60 min, collaborative projects, session recordings, affordable.
- **One-on-One Sessions** — 45 min, custom learning path, personal follow-up, weekly parent reports.
- **Family Sessions** — 2-4 participants, 60 min, family discounts, shared learning experience.

Book via https://qudschool.com/contact.

---

## Certifications

- **Certified Completion Certificate** — official certificate with unique verification number issued upon program completion.
- **Personal Portfolio** — digital portfolio collecting projects and achievements.
- **Competition & Level Certificates** — for competitions and advanced levels.
- **Recommendations & Evaluation** — written instructor recommendation.

Learn more: https://qudschool.com/certifications

## FAQ

**What is QudSchool?**
An AI-powered educational platform teaching programming, computer science, robotics, game development, and AI to children and teens in Arabic and English.

**What ages?**
Primary-stage children through teenagers, with progressive tracks by age and level.

**What languages?**
Arabic (default, RTL) and English (LTR).

**What courses?**
Programming basics, web development, game development, robotics & STEM, AI, computer science, and creative computing.

**What is the duration of each course?**
Most courses range 8-12 weeks with 1-2 sessions per week.

**Are there prerequisites?**
No — programs start from zero for absolute beginners.

**Is there a refund policy?**
Yes — full refund within 7 days if unsatisfied.

**Are certificates provided?**
Yes — certified completion certificates upon finishing each program.

**Do students build a portfolio?**
Yes — every student builds a personal portfolio of projects and achievements.

**How do I get support?**
Via live chat, email, or the support page. Team available 6 days a week.

**Can parents track progress?**
Yes — a parent dashboard tracks the child's progress and provides reports.

**Who founded QudSchool?**
Hossam Galal, in 2023, with a team including Hassan Orabi, Omar Essam, and Amr Mohamed Galal.

**Is QudSchool trusted?**
2,000+ students learn on the platform. Collaborates with Google, Microsoft, MIT, Stanford, and UNICEF.
